silhouette.reason: Torpedo body, sickle second dorsal and anal fin, lunate tail, yellow finlet rows: reads as a tuna from the side and top.
fixes: a visible caudal keel ridge on the tail stock in SIDE/TOP

proportions.reason: Body depth, fin placement and pectoral length match a Thunnus thynnus side photo by eye.
fixes: raise the head slightly (blunter snout profile) to match the photo overlay

materials.reason: The back now reads as a glossy metallic blue with a specular streak and the silver spots/bars show on the flank, but the lower flank and belly are a matte grey rather than mirror-silver and the fins are flat dark plastic.
fixes: lower roughness and raise metalness on the lower flank and belly so it reflects like a fish side
slight translucency/lighter tone at the fin margins

detail.reason: Operculum line, eye ring, finlets and the first dorsal spines are present, but there are no fin rays, no lateral line, no corselet scale patch and no gill slit depth in the hero close-up.
fixes: fin rays as shallow grooves on the dorsal, anal and caudal fins (fins.ts)
lateral line and corselet scale patch behind the head in vertex colour/relief

wear.reason: A pristine fish: no frayed fin margins, no scratches, no scale loss.
fixes: slightly frayed fin margins and a few seeded scratches/scale loss on the flank

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the outline and the finlets as a yellow strip, but the body is faceted with visible light/dark triangle patches on the flank.
fixes: a few more rings on the LOD2 body (~700 triangles) and smoothed normals so the flank stops faceting
an intermediate ring count so the LOD0→LOD1 drop (39k→7k) is softer
